description: This file contains migration logic for the Notesnook project, including versioned data transformations, HTML processing utilities, and migration functions for database schema updates.

methods.name: migrateItem
methods.description: Performs versioned migration of a data item based on its version and the target database version.

methods.name: migrateCollection
methods.description: Deprecated function to migrate an entire collection to a specific version.

methods.name: migrateVaultKey
methods.description: Deprecated function to migrate vault encryption keys to a specific version.

methods.name: migrateKV
methods.description: Deprecated function to migrate key-value storage to a specific version.

methods.name: replaceDateEditedWithDateModified
methods.description: Utility to replace or remove dateEdited with dateModified in data items.

methods.name: wrapTablesWithDiv
methods.description: Wraps HTML table elements with a div container for content editing purposes.

methods.name: removeToxClassFromChecklist
methods.description: Removes specific classes from checklist HTML elements.

methods.name: decodeWrappedTableHtml
methods.description: Decodes HTML wrapped in specific div containers back to table HTML.

methods.name: tinyToTiptap
methods.description: Converts HTML content from TinyMCE format to Tiptap format, handling various HTML elements.

methods.name: changeSessionContentType
methods.description: Changes the type of session content items based on their ID.
